newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIM 2006 BOND YIELD GAP TO BUNDS 40-50 BPS - UNIBANK.
newsitem.headline: FIM 2006 BOND YIELD GAP TO BUNDS 40-50 BPS - UNIBANK.

text.p: Danish Unibank expects the yield gap between Finnish 2006 bonds and the corresponding Bunds to trade in a 40-50 basis point range this week, the bank said in its weekly Nordic Markets update received on Monday.
"We look for the 10-year yield spread versus Germany to trade in the 40-50 basis point range in the coming week," it said. The prospect of a steepening yield curve seemed very limited, it added.
"In a positive international market the spread should trade close to 50 bps, while Finland will likely outperform in a negative international market," it said.
The 2001 bond would underperform ahead of an auction on Thursday, Unibank said. "Investors should consider outright sales of Finnish 2001 government bond at 4.85 percent," it said.
